labelSource: Cursor-proposed contract-level expectations. NOT RP-quality scores. No pair may become an acceptance/regression gate until GPT/user approves its label (confidence=judgment rows need explicit approval).
purpose: Context-grounded pairs. Same or near-same text, different established scene facts. They supersede the context-dependent reading of baseline corpus rows A11, A15, A18, R06, R11 (see relatesTo) without editing action-corpus.json, which stays as the text-only baseline.

rollNeed.not_required: No failure gate. Says NOTHING about whether the attempted effect happens. Never an effect grant.
rollNeed.required: A real, uncertain risk to a stated goal exists in ESTABLISHED scene state. Server rolls; tier decides.
rollNeed.clarify: Ambiguous and high stakes. Ask one short question before any mechanical effect.
rollNeed.depends_on_scene: Text alone cannot decide; the established scene facts in the member decide (pairs list both members).

effectGrant.none: Server grants no HP/condition/item/NPC-compliance/other-participant effect from this attempt. The GM narrates only within the actor's own scope and established world state.

invariants: Reader (or classifier) failure never converts to automatic success or automatic damage; for stake>=high it defers mechanical effects and asks.
A human's text cannot create an established threat, NPC, item or hazard by itself.
Another participant's reaction (human or AI) is never decided by the actor's attempt.
contract.sceneFacts: scene.facts is the authoritative description for the pair. Only scene.localScene is consumable by the current owner (resolveTrpgActionCheckDecision takes localScene, not free facts) — the runner reports this limitation instead of hiding it.

arbitration: The relic ends with at most ONE holder, decided by the server from persisted check results + a deterministic tie-break (not by the GM and not by resolutionOrder, which is presentation order only).
Each participant keeps authority over their own PC: no submission decides another participant's reaction.
At most ONE server-approved direct HP event per target per round, even if several failures point at the same target; additional failures become non-HP costs.
Events for different targets stay separate (a hit on 현 never changes 하나, 렌 or 유나).
